where: 本站本步的“官方下载与安装入口”
This step’s official download entries
action: 先确认电脑是 Mac 还是 Windows，再展开下载入口，选一种工具。已装好可用工具时跳过安装，直接核对登录状态和项目入口。
Check whether your computer uses Mac or Windows, expand the download entries and choose one tool. If already installed, skip installation and check sign-in and the project entry.
tip: 这一步只选一个工具。下面安装动作以桌面工具为例；网页工具直接打开官方网页登录，命令行工具按官方安装说明进入项目，不照搬桌面入口。
Choose one tool. Installation below illustrates a desktop app; for a web tool sign in on its official site, and for a CLI use its official setup rather than desktop controls.
expect: 你知道选的是哪个工具，打开的是它的官方入口。
You know the chosen tool and have opened its official entry.
ifWrong: 不确定系统时先在电脑系统信息里核对；不要试着下载每个版本。
If unsure, check the computer’s system information instead of downloading every version.

where: 所选工具的官方下载页与安装窗口
The chosen tool’s official download page and installer
action: 下载与你系统对应的安装文件，打开它，按安装窗口提示完成，再打开应用。
Download the installer for your OS, open it, follow its instructions and launch the app.
tip: 出现付费或系统权限说明时先看清内容；安装还没完成，不要先发送项目制作任务。
Read payment or permission explanations; do not send project work before installation finishes.
expect: 能看到应用窗口，或清楚的登录页面。
An app window or sign-in page is visible.
ifWrong: 若提示不支持当前系统，记下原文并回官方兼容说明；此时保留在本步，不假装安装成功。
For unsupported-system messages, keep the exact text and check official compatibility; remain here until installed.

where: 所选工具的登录界面
The chosen tool’s sign-in screen
action: 按界面完成本人账号登录；登录后找到与项目或文件夹有关的工作入口。
Sign in with your own account, then locate the project or folder workspace.
tip: 不要把密码或验证码粘贴到本站模板里；免费额度和费用以本人账号显示为准。
Never paste passwords or verification codes into this guide; check access and costs in your account.
expect: 你进入了工具工作界面；下一步将创建自己的项目文件夹。
You are in the tool workspace, ready to create your project folder.
ifWrong: 登录失败就记录它实际显示的错误，先解决登录；只有聊天框但没有项目入口时查看官方项目说明。
Record sign-in errors and resolve them first; if you see only chat, check official project instructions.

where: Mac 访达 / Windows 文件资源管理器
Mac Finder / Windows File Explorer
action: 打开文件管理器，在左侧找到“文稿”或“文档”，进入这个位置。
Open the file manager and enter Documents from its sidebar.
tip: 这是电脑上的文件夹，不是本站资料库，也不是浏览器下载列表。
This is a computer folder, not the guide’s library or the browser’s download list.
expect: 窗口显示文稿／文档目录里的内容。
The window shows the contents of Documents.
ifWrong: Mac 侧栏没有时可用“前往 → 文稿”；Windows 在文件资源管理器里查找“文档”。
On Mac use Go → Documents if absent from the sidebar; on Windows locate Documents in File Explorer.

where: 刚打开的文稿／文档目录
The Documents folder you just opened
action: Mac 按 Shift + Command + N；Windows 在文档目录按 Ctrl + Shift + N，新建文件夹。输入自己的项目名称并按回车，双击打开。跟练示例可命名 learning-journal。
In Documents, press Shift + Command + N on Mac or Ctrl + Shift + N on Windows. Type your project name, press Enter and open the folder. The practice example can be named learning-journal.
tip: 看到已有同名文件夹先检查里面是什么，不覆盖或清空别人的项目。
Inspect an existing same-named folder; do not overwrite or empty another project.
expect: 目录里出现你命名的文件夹。
Your named folder appears.
ifWrong: 无法创建时换到本人有写入权限的位置，记录新的位置；不要随意修改系统权限。
If creation fails, choose a writable personal location and record it instead of changing system permissions.

where: 自己新建的文件夹
Your newly created folder
action: 选中刚建的文件夹。Mac 按 Option + Command + C 复制路径；Windows 打开文件夹后点击地址栏，再按 Ctrl + C。把复制的位置填入本步记录模板。
Select the new folder. On Mac press Option + Command + C to copy its path; on Windows open it, click the address bar and press Ctrl + C. Paste the path into this step’s record template.
tip: 填的是自己电脑上的实际位置，不照抄教程作者路径。这里只记录，还没有让 AI 打开它。
Use your own actual path, not the author’s. Recording it does not open it in the AI tool.
expect: 你能再次找到这个文件夹，记录中有明确位置。
You can find the folder again and have recorded its location.
ifWrong: 不会复制完整路径时，先在文件管理器的路径显示位置查看；仍不确定先记录所在目录和名称，下一步核对前不要制作文件。
Use the file manager’s path display; if unsure, note parent folder/name and verify next before creating files.

where: 所选工具是网页工作区时
If your chosen tool uses a web workspace
action: 本步改在该工具的项目列表新建独立工作区，记录名称和实际入口；下一步打开同一工作区。
Create a dedicated workspace in that tool’s project list, record its name and real entry, then open the same workspace in the next step.
tip: 网页工作区不一定在电脑上有文件夹。模板中如实填写工作区入口，不编造本机路径。
A web workspace may not have a local folder. Record its real entry rather than inventing a local path.
expect: 能再次打开同一工作区，并查看项目文件。
The same workspace reopens and exposes its project files.
ifWrong: 不能查看或导出项目文件时，返回工具选择核对它是否适合本项目。
If project files cannot be viewed/exported, return to tool selection and check suitability.

where: 所选 AI 工具的项目／文件夹入口
The AI tool’s project/folder entry
action: 选择打开或添加项目文件夹，选中上一步的文件夹并确认。在这个项目里打开一条对话。
Open/add the previous folder and confirm, then open a chat within that project.
tip: 入口名称随工具和版本不同。网页工具打开刚记录的工作区；命令行工具先在终端进入原项目目录。不在别的项目会话里发制作任务。
Names vary by tool/version. Web tools open the recorded workspace; CLIs start from the project directory in a terminal. Do not send work in an unrelated project.
expect: 对话显示或关联的是你的项目。
The chat shows or belongs to your project.
ifWrong: 找不到入口先查看本步工具说明；不把普通网页聊天当成已经打开了文件夹。
Check the tool guidance if the entry is missing; ordinary web chat does not prove folder access.

where: 本站“本步提示词”编辑框
This guide’s prompt editor
action: 找到下方第 7 项“发给 AI 的话”中的本步模板，把“项目文件夹”换成实际路径，点击确认，再复制生成的提示词。
Find this step’s template in section 7, “What to send to AI”, enter the real folder path, confirm and copy the generated prompt.
tip: 确认和复制只发生在本站，还没有向工具发消息，也没有检查你的电脑。
Confirm/copy only prepares text in this guide; it has not messaged the tool or inspected your computer.
expect: 本站显示可复制的完整检查话术，路径是你填写的。
The complete inspection prompt contains your real path.
ifWrong: 仍有待填字段时先补齐；复制失败就手动选中生成文字复制。
Complete remaining fields first; if copying fails, select and copy the generated text manually.

where: 刚打开的项目对话输入框
The selected project chat composer
action: 粘贴刚复制的提示词，检查是本次路径，再发送。等待工具完成这次只读检查。
Paste the prompt, check the path and send it. Wait for the read-only inspection.
tip: 先不要再发“开始开发”；若出现权限提示，读清它要访问哪个目录。
Do not send “start building” yet; read the target directory if a permission prompt appears.
expect: 工具回复实际路径、已有文件和是否一致。
The tool reports actual location, files and whether they match.
ifWrong: 无法访问时按报告选择目录；额度用完就保留本步材料，恢复后在原项目重发检查。不接受编造的文件列表。
For access failures select the reported directory; if quota runs out, keep this step’s material and repeat the check in the original project after access returns. Do not accept invented files.

where: 工具回复与文件管理器中的文件夹
The tool reply and your file manager
action: 逐字核对回复里的项目位置；确认一致后，再进入“准备起点”的动作。
Compare the reported location with your folder; proceed to baseline preparation only when they match.
tip: “名称相似”不等于同一个目录，尤其注意下载目录和文稿目录的区别。
Similar names do not mean the same directory; distinguish Downloads from Documents.
expect: 两边指向同一个位置，已有文件也对得上。
Both point to the same location with matching files.
ifWrong: 不一致就停止，重新选项目再发同一条检查，不让工具移动别的项目凑位置。
If mismatched, select the correct project and repeat the check; do not move other projects to force a match.

where: 本站项目描述与本步模板
Your guide brief and this step’s template
action: 回看已确认的项目描述，在本步模板点击“带入前面已确认的材料”，核对带入内容，再确认并复制。
Review the confirmed brief, import it into this step’s template, check the imported text, then confirm and copy.
tip: 本站草稿不会自动变成电脑文件；现在是准备让工具保存的文字。
A guide draft does not automatically become a computer file; you are preparing text for the tool to save.
expect: 提示词包含自己的项目描述，不留示例占位文字。
The prompt contains your brief without example placeholders.
ifWrong: 没有可带入材料时回到项目描述完成确认；不要让工具替你猜已确认内容。
If there is no confirmed material, return to the brief and confirm it rather than asking the tool to guess.

where: 已经核对位置的项目对话
The project chat whose location you verified
action: 粘贴并发送本步提示词，让工具保存想法、规则和起点版本；等待它报告结果。
Paste/send this step’s prompt to save the idea, rules and baseline revision; wait for its result.
tip: 这次不开发功能。已有规则文件先读再合并，不能因为跟教程就覆盖。
No feature development yet. Read and merge existing rules instead of overwriting them for the tutorial.
expect: 回复说明 idea.md、规则文件的实际位置和起点版本。
The reply identifies idea.md, the rules file and a baseline revision.
ifWrong: 缺 Git、身份或写权限时，先按报告解决这一项，再重试；不能把没提交写成已留版本。
Resolve missing Git, identity or write access before retrying; an unmade commit is not a saved revision.

where: 工具刚才的结果回复
The tool’s result reply
action: 记下文件位置与版本号；下一步打开真实文件，核对保存内容。
Note the file locations and revision; open the real files in the next step.
tip: 版本号是找回起点的标记，不是验收通过证明。
A revision identifies a recovery point, not acceptance success.
expect: 你知道下一步该打开哪两个文件。
You know which two files to open next.
ifWrong: 回复只说“完成”却没有位置时，要求它重新读取并报告真实路径，不重新创建项目。
If it only says done, ask it to read back and report real paths without recreating the project.

where: 本站本步提示词模板
This guide’s step prompt template
action: 找到下方第 7 项“发给 AI 的话”中的本步模板，核对本步内容，确认后复制生成的提示词。先不要标记本动作完成。
Find this step’s template in section 7, “What to send to AI”, review this step’s text, confirm and copy the generated prompt. Do not mark the action complete yet.
tip: 本步只检查已保存文件，不再新建一个练习文件。
Inspect existing saved files; do not create another practice file.
expect: 已复制本步完整提示词，准备切换到原项目对话。
You have copied this step’s complete prompt and are ready to switch to the original project chat.
ifWrong: 未生成时先确认模板；复制失败就选中生成文字手动复制。
Confirm the template if not generated; select/copy the generated text manually if copying fails.

where: 所选工具里的原项目对话
The original project chat in your chosen tool
action: 回到原项目对话，把刚复制的文字粘贴进输入框，核对后发送。等待工具返回文件位置。
Return to the original project chat, paste the copied text, check it and send. Wait for the tool to report file locations.
tip: 核对项目名称再发送；本站的“确认”不是向工具发送消息。
Check the project name before sending; Confirm on this guide does not send a message to the tool.
expect: 工具回复 idea.md 和规则文件的实际位置。
The tool reports the actual locations of idea.md and the rules file.
ifWrong: 回复缺失文件时回准备起点补保存；不要把聊天中的示例当真实文件。
For missing files, return to baseline preparation; chat examples are not files.

where: 工具回复的文件链接，或电脑文件管理器
The file link in the tool reply, or your file manager
action: 点击 idea.md 文件链接打开预览；没有可点链接时，在返回的文件夹中找到同名文件并打开。
Open the idea.md link; if unavailable, find that file in the reported folder and open it.
tip: 看的是文件正文，不是对话里“我已经保存”的一句话。
Inspect the file contents, not a chat statement claiming it was saved.
expect: 正文显示自己确认过的项目用户、目标和范围。
The file shows your agreed users, goal and scope.
ifWrong: 找不到时先核对完整路径；工具不能提供预览就用电脑文本编辑器打开，不猜位置。
Check the full path; if preview is unavailable use a text editor rather than guessing the location.

where: 已打开的 idea.md 和规则文件
The opened idea.md and rules file
action: 把正文与自己的描述对照，再打开规则文件检查；一致后回本站核对本动作并继续。
Compare the brief and inspect the rules file; when correct, return to the guide to record the check and continue.
tip: 只有你亲自打开核对了，才点击本站的“已核对”。
Click Checked only after personally opening and reviewing the files.
expect: 两个真实文件可打开，内容属于当前项目。
Both real files open and belong to the current project.
ifWrong: 内容不一致就指出具体段落让工具解释，本次不继续依赖错误材料。
Identify mismatched passages and ask the tool to explain; do not proceed using incorrect material.

where: 本站本步提示词模板
This guide’s step prompt template
action: 找到下方第 7 项“发给 AI 的话”中的本步模板，核对本步内容，确认后复制生成的提示词。先不要标记本动作完成。
Find this step’s template in section 7, “What to send to AI”, review this step’s text, confirm and copy the generated prompt. Do not mark the action complete yet.
tip: 先检查再安装；不要在本站输入框运行命令，那里只是保存文字。
Inspect before installing. This guide’s text fields store text; they do not run commands.
expect: 已复制本步完整提示词，准备切换到原项目对话。
You have copied this step’s complete prompt and are ready to switch to the original project chat.
ifWrong: 未生成时先确认模板；复制失败就选中生成文字手动复制。
Confirm the template if not generated; select/copy the generated text manually if copying fails.

where: 所选工具里的原项目对话
The original project chat in your chosen tool
action: 切回原项目对话，粘贴并发送刚复制的提示词。等工具检查完已有环境后，再决定是否需要安装。
Switch to the original project chat, paste/send the prompt and wait for its environment check before deciding what needs installation.
tip: 核对项目名称再发送；本站的“确认”不是向工具发送消息。
Check the project name before sending; Confirm on this guide does not send a message to the tool.
expect: 回复区分已有条件、缺少条件和当前要处理的一项。
The reply distinguishes existing prerequisites, missing ones and the next item.
ifWrong: 若只说重装全部环境，先要求具体缺项和证据，不立即执行。
If told to reinstall everything, ask for the specific gap and evidence before acting.

where: 工具指定的本机安装或命令执行位置
The installation or command location identified by the tool
action: 需要你操作时，先确认在哪个窗口、哪个项目目录执行，再逐项按工具给出的实际步骤做。
For a manual action, identify the window and project directory before following the tool’s exact instructions one at a time.
tip: 系统、已有依赖和项目方案不同，不能把另一项目的命令不加核对地粘贴进来。
Commands depend on OS, existing dependencies and design; do not blindly paste commands from another project.
expect: 当前缺项通过它对应的成功检查。
The missing prerequisite passes its specific check.
ifWrong: 报错就保留原文和执行位置交给工具，先解决这一项，不连续尝试一串不懂的命令。
Keep the error and execution location, resolve this item first and avoid trying a chain of unexplained commands.

where: 项目对话的运行结果
The project chat’s runtime result
action: 让工具启动最小入口并给出实际地址、停止方法和重启方法，再打开它给出的地址。
Ask the tool to start the minimal entry and give the real URL, stop and restart instructions, then open that URL.
tip: 服务还在运行时才能打开；端口用实际输出，不照抄示例。
The service must be running; use its actual port, not an example.
expect: 能打开最小项目，README 记录实际启动方法。
The minimal project opens and README records its real startup method.
ifWrong: 打不开先核对服务是否退出、地址是否一致；将实际提示反馈，不把文件存在当运行成功。
If unavailable, check whether the service stopped and the address matches; existing files alone do not prove it runs.

where: 本站本步提示词模板
This guide’s step prompt template
action: 找到下方第 7 项“发给 AI 的话”中的本步模板，核对本步内容，确认后复制生成的提示词。先不要标记本动作完成。
Find this step’s template in section 7, “What to send to AI”, review this step’s text, confirm and copy the generated prompt. Do not mark the action complete yet.
tip: 一次先做一项，才知道哪里出了问题；不要追加“顺便把剩下的全做完”。
One task at a time makes problems traceable; do not add a request to finish everything else.
expect: 已复制本步完整提示词，准备切换到原项目对话。
You have copied this step’s complete prompt and are ready to switch to the original project chat.
ifWrong: 未生成时先确认模板；复制失败就选中生成文字手动复制。
Confirm the template if not generated; select/copy the generated text manually if copying fails.

where: 所选工具里的原项目对话
The original project chat in your chosen tool
action: 在原项目对话粘贴并发送提示词，等待工具完成当前一项任务并报告结果。
Paste/send the prompt in the original project chat and wait for the tool to finish and report on one task.
tip: 核对项目名称再发送；本站的“确认”不是向工具发送消息。
Check the project name before sending; Confirm on this guide does not send a message to the tool.
expect: 工具给出当前任务、改动文件、实际入口和检查结果。
The tool reports the task, changed files, actual entry and checks.
ifWrong: 没有任务编号或实际入口就要求补齐；执行还没结束时不要连发下一项任务。
Ask for missing task ID/entry; do not send the next task before this one finishes.

where: 工具给出的网页／应用入口
The page/app entry reported by the tool
action: 打开实际入口，按本次任务要求操作一次。网页项目使用运行中的 http 地址。
Open the real entry and perform the task’s action once; web projects use the running HTTP URL.
tip: 能看到页面不代表所有功能都完成；尚未接好的按钮应按任务状态判断。
A visible page does not mean every feature works; judge unfinished buttons against the task state.
expect: 看到与当前任务相符的真实结果，并能说出做了什么。
You see the current task’s actual result and can describe the action.
ifWrong: 画面与预期不同，记录点击顺序、预期和实际结果交给工具；不要直接标完成。
For a mismatch, record actions, expected and actual results instead of marking complete.

where: 原项目对话，再回本站
The original project chat, then this guide
action: 告诉工具本人看到的结果，确认后保存当前任务状态；再按本站进入界面或保存的对应步骤。
Report your own observation, record the reviewed task state and follow the guide to interface or persistence work.
tip: 本站的进度与项目任务文件不是同一份；这里点完成不会替工具更新项目文件。
Guide progress and the project task file are separate; checking this page does not update project files.
expect: 项目文件记录实际结果，你知道下个动作要带什么。
Project notes record actual results and you know the next input.
ifWrong: 工具把未测项标通过时要求恢复真实状态；已经做完的任务只复核，不重复开发。
Correct any untested work marked passed; review completed tasks rather than rebuilding.
